related.title: 大彰化離岸風電場
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移；大彰化離岸風電場改以遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer; Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms centers on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Scotland風分佈與彰化風資源與typhoon，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到大彰化離岸風電場，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以長期capacity與availability為起點，設計一項能區分「spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移」與「遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare scotland wind distribution with changhua resources/typhoons and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from long-term capacity/availability and propose an observation distinguishing spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer from farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains, including uncertainty.

related.title: Hywind Tampen 浮式風電
related.transfer: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Hywind Tampen 浮式風電的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hywind Tampen floating wind must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界首座浮式風場的定量檢核：浮筒排水量、垂盪週期、繫泊與拖回港口的大修；Hywind Tampen 浮式風電則以為油氣平台供電的浮式風場：減碳量、混凝土浮筒滑模、共用錨與孤島電網為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantitative checks of the world's first floating wind farm: spar displacement, heave period, mooring and tow-to-port overhaul; Hywind Tampen floating wind centres on A floating wind farm powering oil and gas platforms: carbon saved, slipformed concrete spars, shared anchors and an island grid, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「浮式平台的靜傾角」的模型移到Hywind Tampen 浮式風電，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Static heel of a floating platform" to Hywind Tampen floating wind, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「掃掠面積與比功率」與「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Hywind Tampen 浮式風電的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Swept area and specific power" and "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hywind Tampen floating wind must be respecified.
